{
  "name": "game-stance",
  "displayName": "GAME MODE · Stance",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "The permission mode as a colored badge at the right of the prompt footer: 기본, 자동 승인, 계획, 자동 판정, 우회, 묻지 않음; follows shift+tab",
  "author": {
    "name": "Reason of Moon",
    "url": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods/tree/main/plugins/game-stance",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "game-mode",
    "permissions",
    "footer",
    "mode"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "intensity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intensity",
      "description": "off leaves the footer to the engine; casual draws the badge; hardcore adds what the mode lets Claude do",
      "default": "casual",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "casual",
        "hardcore"
      ]
    },
    "palette": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Palette",
      "description": "nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (use it on a light background)",
      "default": "nes",
      "options": [
        "nes",
        "gameboy",
        "amber",
        "theme"
      ]
    }
  }
}
